answer: Each identity must anchor a delivery promise to a marble tablet, naming one artifact due by epoch end, locking 70 credits. A willow keeper checks delivery on the marble record: a missed or fake delivery flags it, and two flags burn the bond. First 36, the k-th 36+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000, locking 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented couriers fail: one courier cannot serve two tablets. An honest agent pays 36 once, keeping its anchor.
